design: Targeted rapid evidence and provenance review; not systematic, exhaustive, preregistered or independently double-screened.
protocolTiming: Queries and selection adapted to population transfer and source discrepancies. This log consolidates actual searches after initial orientation; no prospective registration claimed.
reviewerRole: Maintaining agent; single-reviewer extraction and critical appraisal.
retrievalSystem: Web system1 discovery; primary publisher, PubMed, PMC and author-institution published PDF where accessible. No comprehensive database export.
languageAndDates: English queries and accessible English content by cutoff. No lower publication bound except recencyDays filters recorded per query; these are discovery filters, not source publication guarantees.
inclusion: Original equation proposals and human primary comparisons relevant to the nine specified claim families, plus source-cohort provenance and input-device evidence.
exclusion: Reviews used for discovery only unless the original equation proposal; no unverified primary findings imported from secondary summaries. No participant data admitted.
